## Checklist

- [ ] `cargo fmt --all --check`, `cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets -- -D warnings` and `cargo test --workspace` pass
- [ ] A bug fix has a test that fails without it
- [ ] `SPEC.md` is updated if behaviour changed
- [ ] `docs/PROVENANCE.md` is updated for new algorithms; no code from GPL or proprietary sources ([CONTRIBUTING.md](https://github.com/SilasVogt/newtopo/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md))
- [ ] UI changes have screenshots
- [ ] If an AI agent wrote this, the description says which one
